 At Jammu

sentences.text:
The petitioner submits that the proprietorship land measuring 2 kanal 14 marlas out of 08 kanals and 15 marlas falling under khasra no. 752 in village Kallar, tehsil Mendhar, district Poonch has come to be usurped for the construction of road under PMGSY Scheme without any compensation settled in favour of the petitioner and after exhausting himself in seeking the attention of the authorities in settling the payment of compensation in his favour, the petitioner finds that his grievance is not being attended to, and as such, the present writ petition asking for the respondents to act under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and payment of compensation earning for a land measuring 08 kanals and 15 marlas falling under khasra no. 752 in village Kallar, tehsil Mendhar,
district Poonch.
Petitioner to furnish registered postal covers for the service of the respondents within a period of seven days, whereupon the Registrar Judicial, Jammu to issue notices to the respondents.
